verdict.rationale: Operating a virtual-mailbox SaaS through natural-language commands is a fair axis for this kind of product, but the evidence pack shows no chat, assistant, or natural-language interface. The REST API and Zapier integration are developer building blocks, and automation rules are an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs, and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
